subject: Playbook: qualify-to-commit POC — success criteria, owners, and weekly gates
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + POC proposal and next steps

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to understand Acme Health's clinical ingestion and triage workflows. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight POC so we can get to a commit decision within 4 weeks: 

Summary of needs
- Real-time triage for inbound clinical notes (20-30 reqs/min peak)
- Redaction + private-only storage for PHI-sensitive records
- Latency target: 300ms median, 800ms p95

Proposed POC (3 buckets)
1) Ingest & accuracy: run 5k sample notes through Redwood with current prompt set; target 92% label-match on key fields (patient, encounter_type, priority). Owner: Acme (Luis), partner: Redwood (Marissa).
2) Throughput & latency: staged load test to validate 30 req/min steady-state and p95 under 800ms. Owner: Redwood (Ben).
3) Security/compliance: provide SOC2 summary, KMS flow, and data retention options. Owner: Redwood (Aditya).

Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff + data sample exchange (Acme)
- Week 1: ingest run 1 + baseline metrics
- Week 2: tuning & second ingest; load test
- Week 3: final evaluation and go/no-go decision

Attachments: Redwood-POC-Success-Criteria-v1.xlsx (detailed metrics), SOC2-summary.pdf

Next steps / asks
- Can you share a representative sample (5k notes, de-identified if needed) by Monday 11/16?
- Who will be the primary engineering owner at Acme for ingestion + S3 access (name + email)?
- Do you have any mandatory security controls beyond SOC2 we should account for?

I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Monday if that works — blocked for 9:30am PT.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124

--
Attachment: Redwood-POC-Success-Criteria-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf (1 page)

From: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@acmehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Recap + POC proposal and next steps

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the clear plan. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Sample: we can provide 5k de-identified notes by end of day Wednesday 11/18. I'll send a secure S3 link.
2) Our primary engineering owner will be Luis Ortega (luis.ortega@acmehealth.com); he'll handle S3 and the ingestion job.
3) Security: SOC2 is good start; we also need a short write-up on data retention options (we cannot keep raw notes longer than 30 days). Can you confirm Redwood's option to rotate keys and auto-delete inputs after 30 days?

Success criteria from Acme side (to add to your doc):
- Field extraction F1 >= 0.90 for diagnosis and medication fields
- False positive rate for high-priority alert <= 3%
- No PHI remnants in stored artifacts (we will spot check)

We'd like to kick off Monday at 9:30am PT — Luis, Sara, and myself will attend. See you then.

Best,
Sara
Sara Gomez
Head of Clinical AI, Acme Health
